$notes: Citation registry. Every reference range in metrics.json and every evidence_ref in rules.json must resolve to a key here. `kind` is 'clinical' (peer-reviewed anthropometric/cephalometric norm or aesthetic study), 'position' (professional-body statement) or 'community' (explicitly a convention, shown as such). Before launch, each `clinical` entry needs the exact figures re-checked against the paper — values were entered from the eng doc and from the author's recollection of the literature and are marked verify:true until someone has the PDF open.

farkas1994.cite: Farkas LG (ed). Anthropometry of the Head and Face, 2nd ed. Raven Press, 1994. North American Caucasian adult norms; use the ancestry-specific tables where present.

farkas1994_asym.cite: Farkas LG, Cheung G. Facial asymmetry in healthy North American Caucasians. Angle Orthod 1981;51(1):70-77.

geniole2015.cite: Geniole SN, Denson TF, Dixson BJ, Carré JM, McCormick CM. Evidence from meta-analyses of the facial width-to-height ratio as an evolved cue of threat. PLOS ONE 2015;10(7):e0132726. fWHR vs attractiveness r = -0.26 across 14 samples.

rhee2012.cite: Rhee SC, Woo KS, Kwon B. Biometric study of eyelid shape and dimensions of different races with references to beauty. Aesthetic Plast Surg 2012;36(5):1236-1245. Canthal tilt means by ancestry.

popenko2017.cite: Popenko NA, Tripathi PB, Devcic Z, Karimi K, Osann K, Wong BJF. A quantitative approach to determining the ideal female lip aesthetic and its effect on facial attractiveness. JAMA Facial Plast Surg 2017;19(4):261-267.

powell_humphreys1984.cite: Powell N, Humphreys B. Proportions of the Aesthetic Face. Thieme-Stratton, 1984. Nasofrontal angle 115–130°.

armijo2012.cite: Armijo BS, Brown M, Guyuron B. Defining the ideal nasolabial angle. Plast Reconstr Surg 2012;129(3):759-764.

goode1984.cite: Goode RL. A method of nasal tip projection measurement. In: Powell & Humphreys, 1984. Ideal ratio 0.55–0.60.

legan_burstone1980.cite: Legan HL, Burstone CJ. Soft tissue cephalometric analysis for orthognathic surgery. J Oral Surg 1980;38(10):744-751. Angle of facial convexity 12° ± 4°.

naini2017.cite: Naini FB, Cobourne MT, Garagiola U, McDonald F, Wertheim D. Mentolabial angle and aesthetics: a quantitative investigation of idealized and normative values. Maxillofac Plast Reconstr Surg 2017;39(1):4.

ellenbogen1980.cite: Ellenbogen R, Karlin JV. Visual criteria for success in restoring the youthful neck. Plast Reconstr Surg 1980;66(6):826-837. Cervicomental angle 105–120°.

ricketts1968.cite: Ricketts RM. Esthetics, environment, and the law of lip relation. Am J Orthod 1968;54(4):272-289. E-line.

soft_tissue_gonial_norms.cite: Soft-tissue gonial angle norms are poorly standardised; skeletal gonial angle norms (≈120–130°, Björk) are the only published anchor. Treat as provisional.

fink2006.cite: Fink B, Grammer K, Matts PJ. Visible skin color distribution plays a role in the perception of age, attractiveness, and health in female faces. Evol Hum Behav 2006;27(6):433-442. See also Jones AL et al. 2016 on skin homogeneity.

coetzee2009.cite: Coetzee V, Perrett DI, Stephen ID. Facial adiposity: a cue to health? Perception 2009;38(11):1700-1711. See also Re DE, Rule NO 2016 on facial adiposity and attractiveness.

norwood1975.cite: Norwood OT. Male pattern baldness: classification and incidence. South Med J 1975;68(11):1359-1365.

ward2018.cite: Ward B, Ward M, Fried O, Paskhover B. Nasal distortion in short-distance photographs: the selfie effect. JAMA Facial Plast Surg 2018;20(4):333-335. Nasal base ~30% wider at 12 in than at 5 ft.

langlois2000.cite: Langlois JH et al. Maxims or myths of beauty? A meta-analytic and theoretical review. Psychol Bull 2000;126(3):390-423.

leder2016.cite: Leder H, Goller J, Rigotti T, Forster M. Private and shared taste in art and face appreciation. Front Hum Neurosci 2016;10:155.

bos2025_mewing.cite: British Orthodontic Society statement on 'mewing', May 2025: no scientific evidence that facial shape can be changed this way. American Association of Orthodontists warning, March 2025.

aad_sunscreen.cite: American Academy of Dermatology: daily broad-spectrum SPF 30+ recommendation.

otc_retinoid_azelaic.cite: Adapalene 0.1% OTC: Thiboutot D et al. J Am Acad Dermatol 2018 (practical management); azelaic acid for tone and redness: Fitton A, Goa KL. Drugs 1991;41(5):780-798, and later RCTs. Named as classes; never dosed in-app.

hair_care_basics.cite: American Academy of Dermatology: hair care tips (gentle washing, limit heat and tension, condition). No clinical effect size; weak evidence.

aad_acne.cite: American Academy of Dermatology guidelines of care for the management of acne vulgaris (2024 update): benzoyl peroxide, topical retinoids, salicylic acid as first-line OTC/Rx options.

sleep_attractiveness.cite: Axelsson J et al. Beauty sleep: experimental study on the perceived health and attractiveness of sleep deprived people. BMJ 2010;341:c6614. Sundelin T et al. 2017.

body_fat_face.cite: Facial adiposity tracks BMI and body fat percentage (Coetzee 2009; Tinlin RM et al. 2013). Rate-of-loss guidance (0.5–1% bodyweight/week) is standard sports-nutrition practice (Helms ER et al. 2014).

grooming_brows.cite: Grooming conventions: brow shaping, haircut-to-face-shape matching. Stylist practice; no clinical evidence.

photo_technique.cite: Ward et al. 2018 (distance distortion); general photography practice on lighting direction and lens distance.

minoxidil_finasteride.cite: Adil A, Godwin M. The effectiveness of treatments for androgenetic alopecia: a systematic review and meta-analysis. J Am Acad Dermatol 2017;77(1):136-141. Named only; never dosed in-app.

tretinoin.cite: Topical tretinoin for photoaging and acne: prescription-only in the US; named with a referral, never dosed.

orthodontic_referral.cite: Orthodontic and orthognathic assessment is specialist territory; the app names the option and stops.

community_convention.cite: Looksmaxxing community convention with no located clinical norm. Shown with the 'Community metric, little evidence' badge; score weight capped at 0.02.
